description_en: Pre-validates whether a site name is available
description_zh: 预校验一个站点名称是否可用
name: CheckSiteName

Description.description_en:
The description of the validation result. Valid values:

success: Success.
Site.AlreadyExist: The user has already added this site.
Site.InvalidName: The site name is invalid.
Site.SubSiteUnavailable: The subsite is unavailable.
Site.InternalError: Other errors
Description.description_zh:
校验结果的描述。取值：

success：成功。
Site.AlreadyExist: 该用户已添加过此站点。
Site.InvalidName：非法的站点名称。
Site.SubSiteUnavailable：子站点不可用。
Site.InternalError：其他错误

IsSubSite.description_en:
Indicates whether the site is a subsite. Valid values:

true: The site is a subsite.
false: The site is not a subsite
IsSubSite.description_zh:
是否是一个子站点。取值：

true：是子站点。
false：不是子站点

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the validation is passed. Valid values:

true: Passed.
false: Not passed
Passed.description_zh:
校验是否通过。

true：通过。
false：不通过
